comment: Blessed from the pinned engine, hand-checked against a corrected measured table: the same household again, with all four earlier links answered so the split is still ALIVE (divorced or separated, in the parents' legal custody on July 2, lived with a parent more than six months, the parents paid more than half the support) and the written declaration answered `nobody_did`. `parentalSomeParentNotClaiming` is false, so `eligibleForBenefitSplit` is false and the child is again claimed under the ordinary rules — every served line equal to wages-and-child-single to the cent. Its counterfactuals are tests, not fixtures: `i_did` and `they_did` are refused by name (the custodial-parent tier), and a stepchild, foster child or grandchild row is refused as the non-parental tier.
